title: nan
authors: Xu J.; Bala M.; Eiszler T.; Chen X.; Dong Q.; Chanana A.; Pillai P.; Satyanarayanan M.
key_contribution: Presents TerraSLAM, a 3D GIS-based global positioning system that enhances visual SLAM for GPS-denied localization with GPS-RTK-comparable accuracy, validated in drone localization scenarios.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
